summary: Iteration 7: Focused testing on LEAD EDIT feature (owner) and public /share dashboard's new All Leads panel, plus regression on owner-only endpoints. 9/9 backend pytests pass; frontend edit modal + /share board render fully in a real browser.
action_items: Optional: consider POST /api/admin/reseed to reset lead LD26000001 to pristine values (test restored name/status/mobile via PUT but any downstream recompute residue is negligible).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_lead uses body.model_dump() with all LeadIn defaults. Frontend EditLeadModal correctly pre-fills every field so nothing is clobbered, but any future consumer sending a partial body (e.g. only {customerName}) would reset interestedModel/variant/executive/budget to defaults. Consider making PUT /leads/{id} accept a partial (exclude_unset) update to be safer.
share_dashboard's allLeads rows omit leadId; that's fine for the current UI but exposing leadId would let the public board deep-link or key React lists more stably.
test_credentials: Owner: owner@euler.com / euler@123 ; Executive: executive@euler.com / euler@123
seed_data_creation: None. Modified LD26000001 during test then restored (name/status/mobile back to originals via a second PUT).
context_for_next_testing_agent: LEAD EDIT works end-to-end: PUT /api/leads/{id} requires auth (401 without), owner successfully updates customerName/currentStatus/mobile, and recompute_lead preserves commercial fields (customerPayable, totalReceived, customerOutstanding) — verified by comparing before/after GETs. UI: /leads -> click row-LD26000001 -> edit-lead-btn -> edit-name/edit-status/edit-mobile -> save-edit-lead-btn closes the modal and drawer immediately reflects new values with 'Lead updated' toast. Public /share renders hero, 4 KPI cards, Active Bookings (3), Retail, Active Bookings by Model chips, and NEW All Leads panel with 10 .lead-badge entries (matches totalLeads=10 from GET /api/share/dashboard). No 'Loading board…' issue observed in real browser. Owner-only endpoints (/api/reports/insurance-payout, /api/reports/dealer-earnings, /api/integrations/gsheets/backfill) return 200 for owner and 401/403 for executive.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
